'''Predrag Cvitanović''' ({{IPA|sh|tsʋitǎːnoʋitɕ, - tsʋǐta-|pron}}; born April 1, 1946) is a theoretical physicist regarded for his work in [[chaos theory|nonlinear dynamics]], particularly his contributions to [[Quantum chaos#Periodic orbit theory|periodic orbit theory]].

==Life==
Cvitanović earned his B.S. from [[MIT]] in 1969 and his Ph.D. at [[Cornell University]] in 1973.  Before joining the physics department at the [[Georgia Institute of Technology]] he was the director of the Center for Chaos and Turbulence Studies of the [[Niels Bohr Institute]] in Copenhagen.

Cvitanović is a member of the [[Royal Danish Academy of Sciences and Letters]], a corresponding member of [[Croatian Academy of Sciences and Arts]], a recipient of the Research Prize of the Danish Physical Society, and a fellow of the American Physical Society.<ref name="Academies"/>

In 2009 Cvitanović was the recipient of the prestigious Alexander von [[Humboldt Prize]] for his work in turbulence theory.<ref name="Humboldt"/>

He currently holds the [[Glen P. Robinson]] Chair in Non-Linear Science at the [[Georgia Institute of Technology]].<ref name="Academies"/>

==Scientific work==
Perhaps his best-known work is his introduction of cycle expansions&mdash; that is, expansions based on using periodic orbit theory—to approximate chaotic dynamics in a controlled [[Perturbation theory|perturbative]] way. This technique has proven to be widely useful for diagnosing and quantifying chaotic dynamics in problems ranging from atomic physics to neurophysiology.<ref name="Humboldt"/><ref>{{cite journal | author=P. Cvitanovć | title=Invariant measurement of strange sets in terms of cycles | journal=Phys. Rev. Lett. | year=1988 | volume=61 | issue=24 | pages=2729–2732 | bibcode=1988PhRvL..61.2729C | doi=10.1103/PhysRevLett.61.2729 | pmid=10039207 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal | author=P. Cvitanovć | author2=B. Eckhardt | title=Periodic orbit quantization of chaotic systems | journal=Phys. Rev. Lett. | year=1989 | volume=63 | issue=8 | pages=823–826 | bibcode=1989PhRvL..63..823C | doi=10.1103/PhysRevLett.63.823 | pmid=10041194 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal | author=R. Artuso | author2=E. Aurell | author3=P. Cvitanović | title=Recycling of strange sets: I. Cycle expansions | journal=Nonlinearity | year=1990 | volume=3 | number=2 | page=325| bibcode=1990Nonli...3..325A | doi=10.1088/0951-7715/3/2/005 | s2cid=250889857 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal | author=R. Artuso | author2=E. Aurell | author3=P. Cvitanović | title=Recycling of strange sets: II. Applications | journal=Nonlinearity | year=1990 | volume=3 | number=2 | page=361| bibcode=1990Nonli...3..361A | doi=10.1088/0951-7715/3/2/006 | s2cid=250870355 }}</ref> This theory has been applied by Cvitanović and others to fluid turbulence. Another well-known result is the [[Feigenbaum function|Feigenbaum-Cvitanović functional equation]].
